candidates.new_evidence: A full public ministry-authored social post dated July30 reports the minister's inspection and satisfactory ongoing construction. This is new named physical-work evidence, not a budget, forecast or retrieval-date refresh.

physical_observation.authority_scope: Creator is explicitly the Ministry of Digital Economy, Digitalization and Innovation and the body identifies ACE GABON SA as its supervised state company. The complete visible author-written commentary was read; social comments are not selected. A direct ministry-domain capture timed out, so no independently captured ministry-domain backlink to the social account is claimed.

identity_context.last_modified_context: Visible article says last updated July20. It is not redated or used for fresh physical status.
identity_context.selected_fact: The CEO describes the neutral-hosting project as transforming ACE Gabon's existing landing station; he identifies the operated station as Libreville earlier in the interview. This is a promising same-campus bridge, not a literal street address or approved geometry.
identity_context.limits: The interview calls the company SAS in one answer and SA in another. No legal-form normalization or company-role assertion is selected. Full Q&A read from ordinary credential-free response; the page also contains a generic WordPress newsletter/archive subscription footer. No hidden payload, subscription login or bypass was used.

locator_gate.exact_name_nominatim: ACE Gabon returned [] (two exact bytes). No map point, locality fallback or industrial-zone centroid was substituted.

primary_contrary_context.source_pointer: Choix du PoP body; byte34757 contains site ACE (Ancienne RTG). Footer is Ancienne RTG - Libreville.
primary_contrary_context.finding: The exchange-operator page describes two distinct PoPs and labels ACE as Ancienne RTG, which conflicts with the Angondje station assignment in community and other historical records. This is retained, not silently corrected.

unselected_discovery_routes.finding: The web-readable GABIX POP ACE record gives an Angondje geocode and says its PoP is at the ACE landing station. Not selected as project geometry: source-specific coordinate derivation/rights/CRS and conflicting primary site labels remain unclosed. No raw capture or exact coordinate claim is bound here.

Search-result text identifies the international ACE station at Angondje, avenues Leon Mebiame and Fernande. No PDF was captured or visually reviewed and no coordinate obtained. Staff, security-system and personal-data details are outside scope and not retained.
Search text separates Angondje ACE from CT1 Libreville Ancien RTG1. No PDF capture or visual review is claimed; it does not independently give a numeric locator.

locator_gate.required_next_evidence: A source-specific exact station or project locator with reviewed coordinate convention and rights, then explicit review of the historical landing-station conversion bridge and contrary GABIX labels. A corporate office, reverse-geocoded street, interchange centroid or directory point alone is insufficient.

successor_review.findings: The captured ministry July4 post describes ST DIGITAL GABON as inaugurated. Gabonreview July31 explicitly distinguishes the ACE public project from the private DC opened weeks earlier. These are distinct facilities, and the ST Digital opening does not complete ACE's build. The Carrier Hotel's late-November/early-December delivery remains only a forecast. No ACE completion/cancellation successor through Aug20 was found in the bounded checks; absence is not proven.
successor_review.date_caveat: Ministry ST Digital post literally says inauguration July4; separate news says July3. No exact opening day is selected; both imply completion before cutoff. Similar headline metrics do not establish campus identity.
successor_review.excluded_candidate: ST Digital Nkok, already inaugurated; no construction proposal.

dedup.identity_review: All164 selected physical-site names and stable keys were read. No ACE Gabon / Carrier Hotel / Gabon site is selected. Searches over existing research and curated JSON for Gabon, Carrier Hotel and Doumba found no prior packet before this new round.
dedup.source_key_review: New research candidate key only; no imported canonical project or campus entity is created.
dedup.full_geometry_comparison: Not performed because no trustworthy point or boundary is selected. This remains a required admission gate; no nearest-distance or containment result is claimed.
dedup.mutual_review: Only ACE is proposed for further review. ST Digital Nkok is explicitly excluded as completed, not a second candidate.
